title: Consciousness-based secret space program / bilocating to other planets
plain: An Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, who did remote viewing, an attempt to perceive distant places with the mind alone, says he has travelled to other planets using only his mind, being in two places at once. Asked about this kind of mind-based space program, he answers simply, "Yeah, I've done that." If true, people could reach other worlds without any craft.
